title: 2772. Apply Operations to Make All Array Elements Equal to Zero

examples.explanation: We can do the following operations: - Choose the subarray [2,2,3]. The resulting array will be nums = [1,1,2,1,1,0]. - Choose the subarray [2,1,1]. The resulting array will be nums = [1,1,1,0,0,0]. - Choose the subarray [1,1,1]. The resulting array will be nums = [0,0,0,0,0,0].
It is not possible to make all the array elements equal to 0.
